title: Cold Storage: The Faces We Left Behind
premise: Eight investigators held since 2274 awaken in unfamiliar sleeves in 2384. Their old case leads through altered relationships and forged consent to three city rulers: artificial minds living inside organic clones. This field is GM-only.

scenes.name: The Resurrection Ward
purpose: Establish the current sleeves, 2384, and the 110-year gap.
Give H01; Serin names the two protected reserves.
Run the first announced continuity pulse and preserve player consent.
minimum: Establish the current sleeves, 2384, and the 110-year gap.
Give H01; Serin names the two protected reserves.
Run the first announced continuity pulse and preserve player consent.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: Ask each player a single sensory and anchor question.
scenes.failureForward: Examining the ward always yields the withdrawal receipt.

scenes.name: Breach of Cold Storage
purpose: Obtain the intact-stack retrieval order H02.
Negotiate, comply under witnessed custody, deceive or evade; no mandatory fight.
Establish a traceable exit toward Rainline.
minimum: Obtain the intact-stack retrieval order H02.
Negotiate, comply under witnessed custody, deceive or evade; no mandatory fight.
Establish a traceable exit toward Rainline.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: Use one demand, one response and one decisive consequence.
scenes.failureForward: Custody becomes escorted investigation, not a dead end.

scenes.name: Rainline: Three Leads
purpose: Visit Quiet Archive, Blue Lotus and/or Relay 17.
Verify one historical identity with independent evidence.
Get H03-H05 from their named sources; skipped packets arrive at Anansi.
minimum: Visit Quiet Archive, Blue Lotus and/or Relay 17.
Verify one historical identity with independent evidence.
Get H03-H05 from their named sources; skipped packets arrive at Anansi.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: Play one lead at four hours, two at five, all three at six.
scenes.failureForward: A failed check changes cost or exposure; indispensable records remain obtainable.

scenes.name: Anansi House
purpose: Establish Marlowe as an independent service AI.
Confront Serin with H06 and confirm the reserves.
Offer the first free anchor, consent and read-only access alternatives.
minimum: Establish Marlowe as an independent service AI.
Confront Serin with H06 and confirm the reserves.
Offer the first free anchor, consent and read-only access alternatives.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: One brief question per skipped source, then Serin and the anchor scene.
scenes.failureForward: Refusing a dive leaves an external maintenance-token or escrow route.

scenes.name: Palimpsest Virtuality
purpose: Distinguish records from memory, reconstruct the gate chronology H07.
Expose the forged consent H08 and recover the audit credential H09.
Let every PC act; no final embodiment proof is assumed from memory.
minimum: Distinguish records from memory, reconstruct the gate chronology H07.
Expose the forged consent H08 and recover the audit credential H09.
Let every PC act; no final embodiment proof is assumed from memory.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: Keep Court, Theatre and Last Broadcast; shorten descriptions, not informed choices.
scenes.failureForward: A safe read-only reconstruction yields the case without personality overreach.

scenes.name: Spire, Council and Final Operation
purpose: Enter by public audit, maintenance, witnessed custody or force.
Establish independent Origin, Embodiment and Authority proofs H10-H12.
Give H13/H16, negotiate and carry out one chosen operation.
minimum: Enter by public audit, maintenance, witnessed custody or force.
Establish independent Origin, Embodiment and Authority proofs H10-H12.
Give H13/H16, negotiate and carry out one chosen operation.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: Entry 15/20/25; council 30/35/40; operation 20/25/30. Do not add a boss phase.
scenes.failureForward: Partial Proof, Control and People outcomes remain meaningful; evidence is not retroactively deleted.

scenes.name: Consequences and Personal Endings
purpose: Resolve evidence, authority and care separately.
Name concrete consequences for witnesses, the reserves and civic staff.
Ask every player what remains theirs and close with the chosen ending.
minimum: Resolve evidence, authority and care separately.
Name concrete consequences for witnesses, the reserves and civic staff.
Ask every player what remains theirs and close with the chosen ending.
optional: Use the full linked chapter for dialogue, source-specific costs and spotlight options.
scenes.cut: One public consequence, one relationship consequence, one choice per player.
scenes.failureForward: An incomplete operation creates a contested but playable future, not automatic annihilation.

redundancyRule: Never gate an essential clue behind a successful roll or a compulsory recall. Use source-specific external records and named witness fallbacks. Prove artificial origin, organic embodiment and governing authority independently.
